question: Should status cost display use an exact full-transcript scan, a cache-backed/maintained aggregate, or a bounded/stale-safe value when cached cost is unavailable?
rationale: The code can be repaired in multiple ways, but the acceptable tradeoff between exact cost and status responsiveness is a product/maintainer choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Use cached or bounded status cost
options.body: Keep the default status paths responsive by reading cached/maintained cost when available and showing no/stale-safe cost while a background refresh catches up.

options.title: Accept exact full scans
options.body: Allow status to scan full transcripts for exact cumulative cost, explicitly owning the responsiveness cost for long sessions.

options.title: Pause for aggregate storage design
options.body: Hold this PR until the permanent session aggregate owner is settled and then wire status to that canonical source.

recommendation.title: Use cached or bounded status cost
recommendation.body: Keep the default status paths responsive by reading cached/maintained cost when available and showing no/stale-safe cost while a background refresh catches up.
